analytic_scope.fingerprints: IID offsets; L is the least integer with 64*p^2*3^L<=4^L. For ideal uniform randomness, quartic Weil bounds give global bad-fingerprint probability <=1/64 per declared union bound.
analytic_scope.nonclaims: No hardness, efficient quantum decoder, quantum advantage, novelty, passive-data transfer, or consecutive-query transfer.
analytic_scope.randomness: Saved tests use domain-separated deterministic PRNG streams; probability bounds concern the ideal-random algorithm, not empirical success rates.
analytic_scope.time_queries_memory: O(sqrt(p)*polylog(p)) chosen queries, classical time and memory; public Legendre computations and nonsquare rejection are charged separately. This is exponential in log(p).
analytic_scope.width_failure: Conditional on valid center and good fingerprints, each attempt misses with probability <=1/16; three independent preset attempts give <=1/4096. Fingerprint error is separate.
analytic_scope.width_offsets: Uniform nonzero offsets: wrong quotient agreement <=(p+3*sqrt(p)-2)/(2*(p-1))<=3/4 for p>=37.

center_method: Deterministic cover t=0,...,B-1 and u=j*B mod p, B=ceil(sqrt(p)); at least one exact center collision conditional on injective random fingerprints.
native_contract: Growing odd prime p>=37, hidden monic irreducible quadratic; only chosen base-field character queries. Output b,c with independent random-query verification.
source_boundary: Attack receives p, native oracle closure, and public seed only; no coefficients, source values, extension queries, or full-table preprocessing.
width_method: Public nonsquare eta by random rejection; reference and hidden fingerprints on F_p^*/{+1,-1}; first list distinct, second independent uniform with replacement. Three preset attempts maximum, stop on verified success.
